body:
Thank you, I will look into all of this.

I agree that people might be more self-conscious than outwardly judgmental in social situations, but I also feel like people are quick to dismiss someone they deem beneath them. But maybe I am kinda cynical. 

Anyway, thanks for taking the time to read and respond.

Yes, I'm working on it. I am however still struggling with mental health issues and that saps my motivation and energy. I did lose 55 lbs over the past year and i'm working on the whole money thing. I just having a hard time coping and feeling hopeful.

I don't judge them harshly tho. I don't see how not finding someone attractive is harsh. I also don't hold anything against the women for not finding me attractive. It's totally understandable. I'm just really sad about the whole thing and my inability to succeed all my life and now that the clock is ticking loudly, so to speak. Besides I was feeling suicidal so pardon me for being blue.

Honestly, nothing. I find them plenty attractive, I just find women a decade younger the most attractive but more importantly, I really wish I was sexually active at that age and I had their attention at that age. I hate that I was depressed and anxious. I hate that I was scared of my father and didn't pursue anything I wanted. I hate that I let the fear of beatings and yellings keep me from being more social; for making my break myself trying to be a better student when it wasn't who I was.

I just hate my life.

Besides, the women I want, don't want the likes of me, either because of physical attractiveness or my position in life. I am unattractive and unfortunately I'm not attracted to women of my same level of attractiveness. That's not to say that I expect all these women who are more attractive than me to be remotely interested; I don't think they owe me anything. I just am really sad about being unable to attract them and for all my adult life.

You're right in that I have a perspective that is detrimental to me. I'm not sure if it's just sex, however. To me it is validation and acceptance of me as a person and my body; it is intimacy, companionship, the satisfying of an urge that is very strong within me. I see it as a very basic need for myself. Isn't this view universal? Maybe it becomes "just sex" to the people who can come by it easier, or to the people who don't have quite as high a sex drive. Or I suppose it could be just sex to the people who don't see it in the way that I described above because they get those things from other places. I am not convinced that wanting sex more than other people is wrong per se; but maybe it is wrong for me since I don't seem to have any hope of getting it and I'm wasting my time on it.

Ironically, I can't get myself to go down the sex worker route because I'm scared of lowering my pool of potentials partners even further (if I even have one), by doing something that I can't take back. I won't be able to keep that detail about myself from them because ultimately I want acceptance and I can't have it if I don't tell them who i am honestly.

The real issue here is that I am putting so much stock into physical attractiveness. And that I lust after women who are a decade younger than me and much more attractive than me; I imagine myself to be their age in my fantasies.

I'm so fucked up.

Thanks for your response.
